display.title: Episode 398: The Birth of the Shpoler Zeide (Erev Sukkos)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's pre-Sukkos show: the sukkah's holy shadow of faith and the Ushpizin, Shema with a five-year-old, and how a hidden tzaddik blessed Reb Boruch with a son, the Shpoler Zeide.
display.summary_long: Broadcast between Yom Kippur and Sukkos 5750. Uncle Yossi explains that right after Yom Kippur we begin building the sukkah, a mitzvah that surrounds the whole body, our clothes and even the dishes. The Zohar calls the sukkah's holiness 'the shadow of faith', and each night the Ushpizin, from Avraham to Dovid HaMelech, visit us. The best decoration is a real smile, and inviting someone who has no sukkah. After the Hakochainik march, a five-year-old girl from Crown Heights leads the Shema. The story continues last week's theme: Reb Boruch, who always welcomed guests, hosts a plain-looking traveler and his wife for Shabbos. At midnight a bright light shines from the guest's room, and through the keyhole Reb Boruch sees him saying Tikkun Chatzos beside a shining figure, the Maharal of Prague. The hidden tzaddik promises Reb Boruch a son who will carry the Maharal's soul, and at the bris blesses the baby, Aryeh Leib, to be a 'Zeide' to all Israel. The guest was the Baal Shem Tov. The show ends with Tzivos Hashem's Chol HaMoed 'Sukkos Experience' fair and candle lighting for Shabbos and Yom Tov.
display.lesson: Do mitzvos with real joy and share them with others; a warm welcome to guests can bring great blessing.

date.note: 'Already after Yom Kippur, a few days before Sukkos'; candle lighting 'Friday the 13th of October, Erev Shabbos and Erev Sukkos' fits 5750, so the Tuesday show is 10 Oct 1989.
